description.zh: 是否执行强制删除镜像。默认值：false
description.en: Specifies whether to force delete the image. Default value: false.
The list of image IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
调用该接口时，您需要注意：
- 已共享给其他用户的镜像，需要您取消所有共享后才能删除。
- 正在被其他实例使用的镜像，需要您指定强制删除。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description
When you invoke this operation, take note of the following items:
- If an image has been shared with other users, cancel all sharing before you delete the image.
- If an image is being used by other instances, you must specify force delete.
